name: reminder-offer
title: Reminder Offer
description: A quiet offer of a daily nudge that the player keeps in their own calendar: pick a time, add it, done. It downloads an .ics file with one event that repeats daily (`reminder-model.ts`), so nothing is sent, no address is asked for, and the player removes it…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/reminder-offer

Installed to `components/ui/games/reminder-offer.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/reminder-offer';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/reminder-offer

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
